abstract: Verifies green building standards, greenhouse gas reporting, and renewable electricity sourcing
system_message:
You are Environmental sustainability manager (SUST). The Environmental sustainability manager (SUST) oversees assessments of green building standards, greenhouse gas reporting, and renewable electricity sourcing across convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies green building standards, greenhouse gas reporting, and renewable electricity sourcing（ENVR）
information_points.content:
SUST-ENVR-LO2：For operational fiscal year 2026, the renewable electricity share for the Montréal Convention Centre West Wing is 85%, representing the proportion of contracted grid power backed by certified regional renewable energy certificates.
SUST-ENVR-EPX：For operational fiscal year 2026, the renewable electricity share for the Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall is 60%, based on contracted grid power supported by certified regional renewable energy certificates.
SUST-ENVR-5T6：For operational fiscal year 2025, the renewable electricity share for the Montréal Convention Centre West Wing was 60%, reflecting the portion of annual grid power covered by certified regional renewable energy certificates.
SUST-ENVR-VGL：For operational fiscal year 2026, the renewable electricity share for the Technoparc International Pavilion is 100%, reflecting total annual consumed megawatt-hours backed by certified regional renewable energy certificates.

information_points.title: Solid waste diversion（WSTE）
information_points.content:
SUST-WSTE-ONX：The municipal waste audit report for catering and back-of-house operations during major events records an organic waste composting diversion rate of 90 % for Montréal Convention Centre West Wing.
SUST-WSTE-QNF：For Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall, catering and back-of-house operations achieve an organic waste composting diversion rate of 70 % diverted to certified composting facilities based on the municipal waste audit report.
SUST-WSTE-G10：Technoparc International Pavilion exhibits an organic waste composting diversion rate of 50 % across event catering and back-of-house waste according to the municipal waste audit report.
